artifacts.name: rootless-installer
artifacts.note: Official Docker rootless install script (https://get.docker.com/rootless, built from docker/docker-install at the pinned commit). The digest is the tamper gate: the installer runs as the agent user and writes executables into its ~/bin, so the bytes that reach execution are pinned here rather than trusted from a moving URL. The pinned revision carries SCRIPT_COMMIT_SHA=ada7a567... and STABLE_LATEST=29.9.1, which is what fixes the extras tarball it then fetches (download.docker.com/linux/static/stable/<arch>/docker-rootless-extras-29.9.1.tgz) — the archive that supplies dockerd-rootless.sh, dockerd-rootless-setuptool.sh and rootlesskit. Bumping this pin is how those three are upgraded; see docs/supply-chain-pinning.md.

artifacts.name: slirp4netns
artifacts.note: Rootless-containers static binary, used only when the host has no slirp4netns package and the distribution has no package strategy. Pinned to a release asset (never releases/latest/download, which is a moving target) and verified before it is installed to /usr/local/bin.

artifacts.name: fuse-overlayfs
artifacts.note: Containers static binary, used only when the host has no fuse-overlayfs package. Pinned to a release asset and verified before it is installed to /usr/local/bin.

images.note: Default agent base image. Digest is the resolved multi-arch manifest list for the tag, so the same reference builds the same image on amd64 and arm64.
Allowed base image (end-of-life upstream; kept because specs name it).
